answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 35956 Country: Pakistan Title: Does islam allow trade of video games Question: I am a businessman and I usually deal in playstation3 video games and consoles. Sometimes I play too is it permissible? Further, I always review the games and if I find nudity then I avoid selling and trading in those titles. Answer ID: 35956 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 116/81/D=1433) You should have mentioned that what types of programme (games etc) does the playstation3 video games contain. However, if there is no nudity in it and there is not complete picture of living beings and music then its business is lawful without any doubt; otherwise it is better to avoid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
